source.original_text:
Attributed ASTIS-authored background completion, not a verbatim numbered paper theorem.
Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², let 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X∼μ,Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. The laws μ,J,ν are probabilities. There exists a Markov kernel S with, for every y, S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)), Λ.IsCondKernel S, Λ.fst=ν and Λ.snd=ν. There exists a selfadjoint bounded T on L²(ν;ℝ) such that for every u, ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere, and ∫Tu dν=∫u dν. Set D=I−T²; this exact full-domain squared defect is positive. Define the actual quotient maps ιu=u+0i, Rg=Re g, Qg=Im g and Cg=conj(g). Then ι preserves norm, Cg=g iff g=ιu for some real u, and there exists a bounded complex-linear positive Dc on L²(ν;ℂ) such that Dc g=ιD(Rg)+iιD(Qg), Dc(ιu)=ι(Du), and C(Dc g)=Dc(Cg), universally on their displayed domains. The operator T, positivity, kernel/law certificates and Dc are produced conclusions. No real Γ/root/descent/inverse is asserted.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let Λ := J.map (fun p : E × E => (p.2,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2))
    let ι : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 ν := Complex.ofRealCLM.compLpL 2 ν
    let R : Lp ℂ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν := Complex.reCLM.compLpL 2 ν
    let Q : Lp ℂ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν := Complex.imCLM.compLpL 2 ν
    let C : Lp ℂ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 ν := Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 ν
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun x => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+x)) - ‖y-x‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      Λ.IsCondKernel S ∧ Λ.fst = ν ∧ Λ.snd = ν ∧
      ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
        IsSelfAdjoint T ∧
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖T u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ ∧
          (T u : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun y => ∫ x, u x ∂S y) ∧
          (∫ y, T u y ∂ν) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
        ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T).IsPositive ∧
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖ι u‖ = ‖u‖) ∧
        (∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 ν, C g = g ↔ ∃ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ι u = g) ∧
        ∃ Dc : Lp ℂ 2 ν →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν,
          Dc.IsPositive ∧
          (∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 ν, Dc g =
            ι (((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) (R g)) +
            Complex.I • ι (((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) (Q g))) ∧
          (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, Dc (ι u) = ι (((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) u)) ∧
          (∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 ν, C (Dc g) = Dc (C g))
decoder_context: The underlying base is a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including zero dimension. The displayed potential is C2 with the two global Hessian bounds; positive ordered curvature and positive capped step are the entire analytic hypotheses.

Measure.tilted denotes normalized exponential tilting. The displayed joint is the pushforward of an independent product with the standard Gaussian; the marginal is its second-coordinate law. Kernel normalization, Markov measurability, disintegration and both stationary marginals are produced conclusions.

Lp exponent 2 denotes AE square-integrable quotient functions on the displayed marginal. Conditional operator action is an AE conclusion, while the displayed kernel density identity holds at every state. Operator multiplication is composition.

compLpL lifts the displayed scalar embedding/real part/imaginary part/pointwise conjugation to quotient classes. Positivity includes selfadjointness. The real operator and its positive squared defect are produced internally; the complex positive lift is a conclusion. No square root or inverse is asserted.

theorem actual_positive_defect_complex_lift
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let Λ := J.map (fun p : E × E => (p.2,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2))
    let ι : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 ν := Complex.ofRealCLM.compLpL 2 ν
    let R : Lp ℂ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν := Complex.reCLM.compLpL 2 ν
    let Q : Lp ℂ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν := Complex.imCLM.compLpL 2 ν
    let C : Lp ℂ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 ν := Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 ν
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun x => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+x)) - ‖y-x‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      Λ.IsCondKernel S ∧ Λ.fst = ν ∧ Λ.snd = ν ∧
      ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
        IsSelfAdjoint T ∧
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖T u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ ∧
          (T u : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun y => ∫ x, u x ∂S y) ∧
          (∫ y, T u y ∂ν) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
        ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T).IsPositive ∧
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖ι u‖ = ‖u‖) ∧
        (∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 ν, C g = g ↔ ∃ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ι u = g) ∧
        ∃ Dc : Lp ℂ 2 ν →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν,
          Dc.IsPositive ∧
          (∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 ν, Dc g =
            ι (((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) (R g)) +
            Complex.I • ι (((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) (Q g))) ∧
          (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, Dc (ι u) = ι (((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) u)) ∧
          (∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 ν, C (Dc g) = Dc (C g)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
  let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
    (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
  let ν := J.snd
  have hBase := CenteredDefectOperator.actual_centered_selfadjoint_defect
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  rcases hBase with ⟨hμ,hJ,hν,S,hS,hSd,hSc,hSf,hSs,U,hU,hUi,hUs,M,hM,T,hTs,hAll,
    q,hq,hTq,hqi,hzero,hD,hRest⟩
  obtain ⟨hι,hfixed,Dc,hpos,hformula,hintertwine,hconj⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.L2RealComplexOperator.exists_positive_complex_lift
      ν ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) hD
  refine ⟨hμ,hJ,hν,S,hS,hSd,hSc,hSf,hSs,T,hTs,?_,hD,hι,hfixed,Dc,hpos,
    hformula,hintertwine,hconj⟩
  intro u
  exact (hAll u).2.2

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.DefectComplexLift

It supplies the probability laws, a Markov kernel S with the every-state normalized reflection density, Λ.IsCondKernel S, both stationary marginals, and the same selfadjoint contraction T with its AE conditional-integral action and preserved mean.
